requirements.text: Have 3+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in backend systems, infrastructure, developer tooling, or developer experience.
Have 3+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in backend systems, infrastructure, developer tooling, or developer experience.
Are a strong debugger and systems thinker who learns unfamiliar systems quickly.
Care deeply about developer productivity, fast feedback loops, reliable systems, and thoughtful abstractions.
Are excited about building the infrastructure that makes coding agents reliable participants in the software development lifecycle.
Have experience with areas like CI/CD, build systems, monorepos, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, testing, or observability - we don’t expect expertise in all of them.

Take pride in owning systems over time, not just shipping them: measuring how they perform in production, diagnosing issues, and continuously making them faster, safer, more scalable, and more reliable.
Are pragmatic, collaborative, and excited to take on increasing scope and ownership over time.
